correctness.rationale: The exact exponential formula follows from Li_{-3}; branch derivatives modulo eleven are calculated exactly. Nine branches are scaled isometries. The tenth has H(t)=7t^2+10t modulo eleven with one simple critical point; Hensel lifting and a square-root analytic coordinate yield G_5=A+121U Psi(t)^2. The two normal residue-ten branches subsume its image. The fiber counts follow from Hensel square roots and eleven lifts; least period follows from mod-eleven aperiodicity and the r=0 scaled isometry. Standalone modular enumeration independently checks every fiber through level five; it is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sequence counts a classical combinatorial family (binary lonesum matrices with exactly three columns) and has a known exact exponential representation, making local representation a natural precise arithmetic invariant. The first singular residue branch at eleven contributes variable and arbitrarily large square-root fiber spikes while changing no attainable residue class. Determining all-depth fibers, least periods and an output Haar measure thus separates support from multiplicity, a mathematically motivated classification beyond table recomputation or simple periodicity.
